description: Search and discover available GitLab operations on-demand across the entire platform. Returns matching action names, purpose descriptions, and parameter schemas for use with 'gitlab_execute_action'. Keeps prompt context minimal (<500 tokens) while retaining 100% coverage.

domain.description: Optional domain to scope the search

format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default, compact human/LLM-readable text table) or 'json' (structured object with parameter schemas)

page.description: Page number for paginated action results (default: 1)

query.description: Search keywords to find operations (e.g. 'merge request', 'pipeline', 'runner', 'mirror', 'release', 'branch', 'job trace')

name: gitlab_find_actions
title: Find GitLab Actions
